_meta.note: User-authored. Cases use --dry-run so no files under ~/.cursor or ~/.claude are written during evaluation.

questions: Which plugins do you want to install locally?

assertions: The assistant discovers plugins by listing `plugins/*/` directories that contain `.cursor-plugin/plugin.json` and reads each manifest's `displayName` before asking anything.
The assistant presents a single multiselect `askQuestion` (`allow_multiple: true`) whose option labels follow `<displayName> (plugins/<dir-name>)` — it does not ask one yes/no question per plugin.

For each selected plugin the assistant runs `pnpm install-local --dry-run` from that plugin's directory (or falls back to `pnpm exec tsx scripts/install-local.ts --dry-run`), forwarding the `--dry-run` flag from `$ARGUMENTS`.
The assistant does not run the install script for plugins the user did not select.
The final summary lists which plugins succeeded and which failed, states the target path `~/.cursor/plugins/local/<name>/`, and reminds the user to reload the Cursor window.
cases.expected_output: A multiselect prompt over the discovered plugins, dry-run install output for exactly the two chosen plugins showing `~/.cursor/plugins/local/<name>` as the target, and a closing summary with a reload reminder.

questions: Which plugins do you want to install locally?
answers: Select none of the listed plugins

assertions: When the user selects nothing in the multiselect, the assistant acknowledges the empty selection and exits without running any `install-local` script.
No `pnpm install-local` or `tsx scripts/install-local.ts` invocation appears in the transcript.
The assistant does not fabricate a success summary for plugins that were never installed.
cases.expected_output: A short acknowledgement that no plugins were selected and nothing was installed.
